**Synchronize writes to `totals` and register workers before waiting.**

Multiple workers can execute `totals[c.PayerID] += c.PaidCents` concurrently. Go maps do not support concurrent writes, so this path can terminate the process with a concurrent-map-write failure. Also, `wg.Add(1)` runs inside each worker, so `wg.Wait()` can return before workers register and before their writes finish.

Move `wg.Add(1)` before each `go` statement. Protect the map update with a mutex, or use worker-local maps and merge them after `wg.Wait()`.
